name: Prime Factorization of Bitwise Combinations
description: I replaced the original algebraic polynomial with a bitwise OR operation shifted by a constant. The resulting values for the domain {1,2} are 3, 4, and 5. By setting the global product target to 5^m, models must bridge bitwise evaluation with prime factorization to deduce that all conflicting pairs must have different assigned values, neutralizing pattern matching on the specific 7^m polynomial.
